content.text:
I couldn't compare my fund. The page added it to the list, but next to it there's just "עוד לא נאסף" and "אין מחיר כאן", so no shekel figure at all. I'm fairly sure that's what it says. I don't really know why. The page's top pick is still Psagot with "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", which leaves 86,492 ₪ after 10 years. If I had to do something today I'd probably just go with that, but I didn't get the comparison I came for.

**How it went:**
- **Top of the page:** the heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד" was what I wanted. S&P 500 was already picked. I left the sliders alone (10,000 ₪ today, 500 a month, 10 years, 7%). The big number 86,492 ₪ with "הזול" on it is the one that stuck.
- **Fund list:** I scrolled down looking for my iShares. It's there, marked "הזנתי" with "דמי ניהול שנתיים: 0.05%", but where the money should be it says "עוד לא נאסף" and "אין מחיר כאן". The other foreign ones (Vanguard, iShares Core, IVV, VOO) say the same thing.
- **Why no price:** there's a note under the list, "למה חלק מהקרנות בלי מחיר בפסגות". I read its first line, "בתעריפון אין שורה לניירות ערך זרים", and stopped there.
- **Right-hand column:** I saw the first number, Psagot 86,492 at the top of a list of banks. Further down, Interactive Brokers shows 82,848 ₪, but that's for "iShares Core... (Accumulating)", not my Swap one. I didn't get why one place has a number for an iShares fund and another doesn't.

**What I skipped or skimmed:**
- The coloured bar with the costs. The legend has words like "דמי משמרת" in it.
- The block "מה כתוב בפרסום, מול התעריפון".
- The chart below that I skimmed. At "עם נטרול מט"ח או בלי" I stopped; that's where I'd have closed the page.

**Words I didn't get:**
- "עוד לא נאסף" (not collected by whom?)
- "נטרול מט"ח", "חשיפה לדולר", "סטייה מהמדד", "צוברת"
- "4D"/"4A", "W-8BEN", "מס עיזבון אמריקאי"
- "−43 ₪ לעומת הבחירה שלכם": the minus scared me a bit

**What bothered me:**
- My fund is on the list but there's nothing to compare it to. It also sits next to a red tag, "מס רווח במכירה".
- One fund has a huge range: "בין +2,212 ₪ ל־ −23,766 ₪".
- There are dozens of funds that all look the same.
